description: List gems that depend on this gem. Useful for understanding ecosystem impact ("what depends on Rack?") or risk surface ("how many gems would break if this one had a vulnerability?"). API caps at 50 names per request.
name: get_reverse_dependencies

count.description: Total number of gems that depend on this one

dependents.description: Names of gems depending on this one (up to 50)

has_more.description: Whether there are more than 50 dependents

hint.description: Error message when gem not found

title: Get Reverse Dependencies
